patches.title: Patch 1.30: Balance and fixes
patches.summary: Version 1.30 brings adjusted cards, abilities, tox and talents: Extortion now truly steals your opponent's Spamtons, Phoenix Feather works for sure once per game, and Judgment-6 replaces Judgment-8. It also fixes Freeze, end-of-game draws, the match history and the chat.
additions: Tox shop: Under «Reroll», the odds of each rarity are now shown in a column, and a rarity at 0% is no longer listed.

Absorb: The text now says what absorption has done since 1.29: the card gains max HP equal to the absorbed card's, without healing.
Match history: The game you just finished now shows its numbers right away: damage, kills, talents and stars.
Chat: The current conversation stays selected when a friend's status changes: your message no longer goes to another friend.
End-of-game screen: The button you click now shows that it is loading, the other one greys out and the click can be heard: the screen no longer seems frozen.

patches.title: Patch 1.29: Balance and fixes
patches.summary: Version 1.29 brings adjusted cards, abilities and talents, a new ability for the Leviathan of the Skies, and Revitalization, which now heals for sure once per game. It also fixes Smoke, Camouflage, HP thresholds and deaths that did not play out.
additions: Level up: When you level up, a «LEVEL UP» animation now appears on the menu and on the end-of-game screen.
Separate queue: Accounts flagged by our bot detection now play in a separate queue: they only face accounts in the same situation, and their games no longer count toward stars or the leaderboard.

patches.title: Patch 1.28: Secret of the Oniyx
patches.summary: Version 1.28 opens the game's first expansion, Secret of the Oniyx : 24 new cards, a new Tox, Camouflage, and the Oniyx Orb, which guarantees at least one of them. Ranked changes too: no more bonus star for streaks from Celeste up, and a monthly reset by tiers starting November 1.
additions: Secret of the Oniyx: 24 new cards: The game's first expansion is here: 24 new cards, four per element, with their artwork and their stories. The new What's new window introduces them, and they can drop from your orbs right now.

New Tox: Camouflage: The card can't be targeted. It is revealed until its next turn when it attacks or receives a tox. Camouflage is lost when it is the last card alive on its side or when Fatigue hits it. Area attacks and random targets still hit it. You can buy it in the Tox shop, and three cards of the expansion start with it.

Oniyx Orb: An event orb with 4 cards, at least one of them from Secret of the Onyx. It costs 1000 Crystals, like the Classic Orb, and each player can buy 3, from the game's home screen or the What's new window.

Elemental Orb and FA Orb: These orbs now only draw styles you are missing, on cards you own. If your collection is already complete, the slot is refunded in Spams ("Collection complete"). They no longer give a Spams bonus.

Missions: an Oniyx Orb every week: The weekly mission "Complete all your missions" now gives an Onyx Orb instead of a Classic Orb. And from November 1, the monthly mission "Kill 40 legendary cards" becomes "Buy 200 epic Toxs".

Ranked: streaks and monthly reset: From Celeste up, a win streak no longer gives an extra star. And at the start of each month, ranks now drop by tiers instead of everyone going back to Bronze: Legend and Celeste return to Celeste 1, Crystal and Gold to Gold 1, Silver to Silver 1, and Bronze stays as it is. The first reset of this kind is on November 1.

Tournament Champion Badge: The champion of an official tournament receives the Tournament Champion badge as a gift: a cup showing how many official tournaments they have won. Champions of past tournaments receive it in their gifts too.
Animated avatar: Treasurer: A new animated avatar arrives in the shop, in the image of the Treasurer, one of the new cards.
New end-turn button: It drains as time runs out, changes colour with each turn and warns you in the last 15 seconds.

patches.title: PATCH NOTES 1.26
patches.summary: Version 1.26 rebalances 33 cards, 8 talents and the price of 5 Tox, with two new abilities: Horn 50 for Mythic Horned One and Dark Idea for Moxilys. Elemental and Full Art skins move to a single price, the patch notes get a new look, and the Glossary puts the artists in the spotlight. Several combat and tournament bugs are fixed as well.
additions: Patch notes: new look: The patch notes start with an "At a glance" summary and show right away what changes: for each card, the old value, the new one, and whether it is a Buff or a Nerf.
Glossary: Artists tab: In the Settings, the Glossary has a new Artists tab: pick an artist to discover all their illustrations, alternative arts included.
Elemental and Full Art skins: single price: Elemental and Full Art skins now have a single price that no longer depends on the card's rarity. On top of that, their prices go down.

Early surrenders: To fight accounts that surrender over and over to farm Crystals: surrendering at the very start of a game no longer gives any Crystals or XP, and repeated early surrenders make your next search take longer, up to 5 minutes. Your opponent keeps the win and the rewards.

fixes: Tournaments: three fixes: The Saturday Tournament bracket fits on the screen again, the "READY" button and the deck choice no longer show up when the tournament doesn't accept them, and the final podium no longer opens empty.
Evolution talent: HP thresholds: An Evolution card now always changes threshold at 75, 50 and 25% of its HP, including after a heal, Tenacity or a splash from the AoE Tox.
Smoked: a missed hit no longer reveals the card: A missed attack on a card under Smoked no longer reveals it: it stays hidden.
AoE Tox: no more splash without a hit: The AoE Tox no longer splashes neighboring cards when its carrier neither hits nor heals, for example when it pays an HP cost or takes reflected damage.

Bomba Tox: explosion fixed: The explosion of a Bomba card no longer reuses the effects of the ability that killed it: it no longer lands on the killer's side and is no longer wrongly shown as critical.

Metamorphosis: statuses are cleared: A card that metamorphoses now loses all its statuses (poison, Freeze or Smoked) instead of keeping them in its new form.
End screen: no more "-1" on a win: In Ranked, the end screen no longer shows "-1" star after a win.
Collection: the "Complete" tag clears: The "Complete" tag on an elemental skin now clears once seen, like a new item, and the Collection dot can drop back to zero again.
Tox shop: no more blocked turn: Clicking "Skip" right after a "Ban" or a "Reroll" no longer locks your abilities until the end of the turn.
Crystals gift: A Crystals gift, such as a tournament prize, now shows with the right icon and its real name instead of a white square "Unknown Article".
Steam purchase: missing payment window: If the Steam payment window doesn't open, the game now tells you and explains how to enable it, instead of waiting for a confirmation that can never come.

Starter orb: If you turned down Subject 042's help when you arrived, you never got your starter orb: you now get it as soon as you answer. If your account was created since 1.23 and you didn't have it yet, it's waiting in your orbs.

patches.title: PATCH NOTES 1.25
patches.summary: Version 1.25 brings the talent draft to every tournament, the Draw no longer changes hands at the reset, and the Collection flags elemental skins to complete. Also new: a talent glossary, a reworked orb shop, HP bars that show lost max HP, and several fixes.
additions: "New" filter: In the Collection, a "New" checkbox (with the count) appears when there are new cards, skins or talents: ticked, the grid keeps only the marked cards and the "Mark all as read" button shows up below it. The marks and the Collection tab's dot are also restored correctly after a restart.

Elemental skins to complete: A card you own, with at least one elemental fragment but not the elemental skin yet, gets a green "Complete n/4" tag in the Collection grid and on its elemental skin in the preview. The tag follows your fragment count, counts in the Collection tab's dot, and disappears once you get the skin.
Collection on wide screens: On PC, when the window is wider than 16:9, the Collection grid adds columns instead of enlarging the cards (6 columns in 21:9).

Talent glossary: In the Settings, the Glossary tab now has two sub-tabs: Tox and Talents. Talents lists the talents of playable cards in alphabetical order: click one to see its description and the cards that carry it; clicking a portrait opens that card's preview with the talent.

Reworked orb shop: On PC, in the Shop under Orbs, the classic orb bought with Crystals gets its own block with the "Get" button: the orb charges up while your balance covers the price, and clicking it opens the purchase preview. Orbs paid with Spams sit on a single row of 5 under "With your Spams", the classic orb included.
Rank and win rate in Ranked: On PC, the Play tab in Ranked shows your rank and win rate at the bottom left.

HP bar and lost max HP: A card's HP bar keeps the length of its base HP when it loses max HP: the lost part shows as gray striped with black at the end of the bar, damage preview and history included. The text still reads "HP / max HP".

Talent draft in tournaments: The talent draft (30 seconds) is now played in every tournament, at each game of a Bo3, just like in Ranked. For spectators, the bottom player's talent list stays hidden during the draft, and the shop can be hidden again.
fixes: Steady Draw at reset: At the daily reset, the Draw no longer swaps hands in front of you: there is only one draw per player, per shop and per day, and tomorrow's hand is drawn in advance, so it shows up right at the reset.

Orbs: no more replayed reveal: The reveal of an orb opened earlier is no longer replayed at login or when you open the orbs page: no more "new card" announcements for a card you've already played, and no more missing talents. An interrupted reveal doesn't come back; its rewards are in the Collection, marked as new.
Banned Tox still on display: A banned Tox still shown grayed out in the shop can no longer be bought: the server now refuses the purchase, not just the game.

Smoked and face-down cards: A card under Smoked is turned face down for both players, but some effects kept coming from it and gave away its position: the "spell ready" flash at the end of the turn, the element orbs at the start of the turn, and the flash of some talents. They now stay hidden while the card is face down.

Watch replay: Three fixes in the replay: a card preview opened with a right click now works while paused instead of staying frozen; going back to the start no longer silently replays the talents placed at the beginning of the game, which now count as steps for the previous and next action; and jumping around the replay with the preview open no longer leaves a card stuck.

Bo3 tournaments: absence: In a Bo3, an absent player (time limit exceeded, disconnection of over a minute, cancelled game) now loses only the current game and comes back for the next one; still absent, they lose that one too, and so the match. Forfeiting still gives up the whole match, and Bo1 is unchanged.

patches.title: PATCH NOTES 1.22
patches.summary: Version 1.22 strengthens the six Kings and shortens turns when you have no more moves to make. It also introduces the first alternative card arts. It fixes an orb that remained visible but could not be opened, a game that could get stuck on the first turn, and several Freeze-related effects. [+] ADDITIONS
